summary: Comprehensive backend multi-tenant SaaS testing (30 tests, 100% pass) + frontend smoke tests. Tenant isolation, signup/trial flow, subscription checks, platform admin, existing billing preservation, and staff RBAC all verified. Cross-tenant access attempts correctly return 404. Existing Glow Up bill 20260807-0001 preserved with tenant_id backfill. New tenant signup creates 7-day trial. Platform admin endpoints work and are gated. Frontend rebranded to ParlourPilot with logo, signup screen has all required fields, dashboard shows Glow Up business name and existing bill count, Manage tab shows Salon Settings + Subscription entries. Deprecated packages detected: none. React Native deprecation warning detected: shadow* style props.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Non-blocking but should migrate to boxShadow for RN 0.76+ compatibility. Search codebase for shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius StyleSheet properties.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate shadow* StyleSheet props to boxShadow to silence RN deprecation warnings.
(Optional) Consider adding data-testid attributes to Sign In button, email/password inputs, and signup CTA for more stable e2e testing (currently only text-based selectors work).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1912 lines — consider splitting into routers/ modules (tenants.py, auth.py, bills.py, platform.py) for maintainability (>700 line threshold).
tenant_status() may return status='expired' but the DB document still says 'trialing' — computed status is only reflected via API projection. Consider a background job to persist status changes.
check_subscription() raises 402 on expired — good, but /api/tenants/me and /api/tenants/me/subscription intentionally do NOT enforce it (so users can still view/renew). This is correct.
seed_data_creation: /api/seed endpoint is unauthenticated (line 1680). Fine for demo bootstrap but consider guarding in production.
seed_data_creation: Tests create a fresh TEST tenant via /api/tenants/signup per session and clean up via platform-admin endpoint at module teardown. Also creates transient test bills (deleted). Prefix 'TEST_' used for all test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_multitenant_saas.py — reusable regression suite covering tenant isolation, signup, platform admin, subscription extension, staff RBAC, and existing Glow Up bill preservation. Run: `pytest backend/tests/test_multitenant_saas.py -v`. Public URL: EXPO_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. Note: /api/platform/tenants/{tid} DELETE endpoint referenced in teardown does not exist — cleanup is best-effort; TEST tenants may accumulate over runs but are visibly prefixed 'TEST '.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Multi-tenant refactor is well-implemented: every route uses tq(user) filter that always includes tenant_id from JWT, cross-tenant IDs correctly return 404 (not 403/200), and the Glow Up tenant backfill via ensure_glow_up_tenant() preserved all existing bills/services with tenant_id stamped.
